AccessRequirementsData.description:
Class, race and faction allow-lists. `None` means "no restriction". The
contract cannot express these in `Predicate`, so this is a local input type.

ApplicableBuild.description:
A build this imagery may be reused for. The image's own build needs no
evidence; every other build requires evidence that the imagery still applies.

ChoiceTaken.description: When another group member counts as "choice already made".

ClassProficiency.description:
Categories a class may (`allowed`) or may not (`disallowed`) use. A category
in neither set is unmapped, which is unknown rather than disallowed.

ControlPoint.description:
A pin paired with a travel node whose measured normalized position supplies
the other side of a calibration pair.

residual_px.description:
Distance in pixels between the pin and the node projected through the
calibration; requires a known calibration.

CoordinateTransform.description:
Per-axis affine transform from normalized map coordinates (see `Position`)
into a named target space: `target = scale * normalized + offset` for each
axis. `MapSpace.transform` targets world units such as `"yards"`;
`MapImage.calibration` targets `"pixel"` (full image frame). Negative scales
express axis flips; rotation and shear are not representable.

Copper.description: Unsigned integer copper as a canonical base-10 string (Rust also rejects values above u64)

Dependencies.description:
Versions and inputs the payload was produced from. Absent fields and an
empty snapshot list mean "no such dependency"; each kind fixes which apply.

HandSlots.description: The main-hand slot and the off-hand slot a two-handed item also occupies.

ImageLayer.description:
One raster file of a `MapImage`. Pixel coordinates in pins and calibration
always refer to the full frame; a layer with `frame_divisor` 2 is half size.
`registration_offset_px` is the offset applied to the layer's source crop so
it registers with the frame (zero once the panels are aligned).

file.description: Relative to the content root of the dataset's namespace.

oneOf.description: Terrain with a manually traced road overlay baked in; not verified edges.
Terrain with a reference flight network baked in; not a character's unlocks.
Downscaled copy of another layer for small views.

ImagePin.description:
A labelled point measured on the image, in full-frame pixels. Reference
geography, not an unlock.

measured_on.description: The layer the pixel was measured on.

MapEmbedding.description:
The child map's rectangle inside its parent map, in the parent's normalized
space (GetMapRectOnMap style). Both keys share one exact context.

calibration.description: Normalized map coordinate -> full-frame pixel; units must be `pixel`.

gaps.description: What the imagery does not show or verify (plan section 12.3).

source.description: Registry ID in docs/data/SOURCES.md; not resolved inside a dataset.

PixelPoint.description:
A point in an image frame, in full-frame pixels. The origin is the frame's
top-left corner; x grows rightward and y downward.

Position.description:
A normalized position on one named map/floor/instance space. The origin is
the map's top-left corner; x grows eastward (right) and y southward (down),
both in [0,1], matching the C_Map map-position convention. This orientation
is a documented convention, unverified on the Forever client until the M0.4
checks exist. Positions on different `MapKey`s are never comparable. `map_id`
values follow the addon-exported uiMapID as a decimal string (ADR 0002).

version.description: Producer application version; independent of schema and dataset versions.

ProficiencyTableData.description: Caller-supplied proficiency data keyed by class; core defines no table.

created_at_utc_ms.description: Absent means the producer recorded no creation time.

ReferenceDatasetEnvelope.description:
Deserialization is hand-written (see below) so unknown members are size
checked as raw text before parsing, instead of buffering the whole envelope.

fixture.description: True for synthetic engineering data. Production planning rejects it.

choice_group.description: None means unconditional; matching IDs identify mutually exclusive choices.

RoleProfileData.description:
Weights are integer thousandths (1.000 is stored as 1000), so scoring is
exact integer arithmetic that a later Lua evaluator can reproduce.

SlotLayoutData.description:
Slots the scenario may fill, plus the optional hand relationship. Paired
slots (two fingers, two trinkets) are expressed by candidates listing both
slots in `ItemDefinition.slots`; one candidate is never placed twice.

WeightSource.description:
Where a profile's weights come from. `SyntheticTest` weights are an
engineering assumption for tests, not game truth.

description: Strict reference-content v2 structure. Rust validation checks bounded complete references, provenance and semantics; structural validity is not a rights grant or verified game fact.
